name: FA_SYSTEM_CONTROLS
description: FA_SYSTEM_CONTROLS contains system-wide controls that affect all your assets. This table consists of a single row. LAST_MASS_ADDITIONS identifies the most recent concurrent request for the mass additions create process. LAST_MASS_ADDITIONS_POST identifies the most recent concurrent request for the mass additions post process.

columns.name: COMPANY_NAME
columns.description: Name of an organization with one or more legal entities under common control. This will appear on all reports.

columns.name: DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE
columns.description: Date on which the asset was placed in service.

columns.name: LOCATION_FLEX_STRUCTURE
columns.description: Identifier of the asset location flexfield structure.

columns.name: CATEGORY_FLEX_STRUCTURE
columns.description: Identifier of the asset category flexfield structure.

columns.name: ASSET_KEY_FLEX_STRUCTURE
columns.description: Identifier of the asset  key flexfield structure.

columns.name: INITIAL_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Starting number at which Oracle Fusion Assets begins automatic asset numbering.

columns.name: USE_CUSTOM_ASSET_NUMBERS_FLAG
columns.description: Custom asset numbering scheme used by the system.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
